arguments.rule_content:
rule sigma_rule 'SIGMA-RANSOM-001' {
  meta:
    description = 'Ransomware precursor activity'
  author = 'Sigma Author'
  reference = 'https://github.com/sigmahq/sigma/tree/master/rules/windows/file_activity/vssadmin_delete_shadows.rst'
  tags = ['ransomware', 'vssadmin']
  level = critical
  created = 2022/01/01
  updated = 2022/01/01
  namespace = 'File Activity'
  category = 'File Activity'
  id = 'sigma_rule_001'
  severity = 'critical'

  condition:
    ( event.code == 1 AND ( process.name == 'powershell.exe' AND process.args contains '\\vssadmin\\delete\\shadows\\/all\\/quiet' ) ) OR
    ( event.code == 1 AND ( process.name == 'powershell.exe' AND process.args contains 'Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true' ) )
}
